models.label: Laya (routed)
models.notes: The Laya server selects a checkpoint per request. Set LAYA_BASE_URL to a hosted or self-hosted /v1 endpoint. API cost is not estimated; self-hosting compute is excluded.

pricing.note: Announced preview rate; billing may not yet be enabled. Used only as an estimate.
Published input rate; output tokens are not billed.

models.label: Jev 1.14
models.notes: Native Choice probabilities through OpenRouter's Decisions API. Text and image evidence; images outside TypeSafe's 280 to 1568 px side limits are rescaled to fit (38 bench-v4 rows, flagged per row). Hosted weights may update; returned model identity recorded.

pricing.note: API-equivalent estimate; a Codex subscription is billed differently.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: Claude Code reports its own API-equivalent cost per call.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Haiku does not accept an effort setting. Claude Code reports its own API-equivalent cost per call.

models.label: Sage 1.3 (Levanto)
models.notes: Hosted Sage 1.3, verified on every response. Reasoning auto; no grounding. Native categorical Choice probabilities; null choices count as unanswered and incorrect, not transport errors. Input includes image tokens; output includes billed reasoning. Cost is a token-price estimate at verified Starter rates, not a subscription-per-decision estimate.

pricing.note: Starter token rates verified on the account billing page. Image tokens billed as input; billed output includes reasoning. No web search used. Credits cover usage; this is a list-price usage estimate, not a card charge.

models.label: Tev1 4B Experimental

pricing.note: Announced serverless rate; estimate from API token usage.

models.notes: Native constrained letter output with thinking disabled. Accuracy-only: raw top-5 token logprobs retained; calibration unavailable.

models.label: Perplexity Decider V1.1 27B
models.notes: Native Choice decisions via OpenRouter alpha Decisions API; text and image evidence; probabilities preserved without renormalization.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
models.notes: GPT-6 Luna served through the native Decisions API via OpenRouter; text and image evidence with native Choice probabilities. Separate from the chat-completions GPT-6 Luna benchmark.

models.label: Microsoft Decision 1
models.notes: Native Choice probabilities through OpenRouter. Text only: evaluated on the identical 949 rows without image assets; all 122 image-containing rows excluded. Hosted weights may update; returned model identity recorded.

models.label: Gemini Decision 1
models.notes: Native Choice probabilities through OpenRouter's Decisions API. Text and image evidence. Hosted weights may update; returned model identity recorded.

models.label: Kev 4B
models.notes: Kev 4B through OpenRouter native Decisions API; not the Kev-27B requested in GitHub issue 16. Evaluated on the identical 949 text-only rows; all 122 image-containing rows excluded. OpenRouter lists 8,192 token context; returned checkpoint recorded.

models.label: Kev 27B (Kev 1.0)
models.notes: Kev-27B v2 full bf16 weights, temperature 1.32, pinned Hub revision af0e6d551bdc2cc724f3e9d7a8bee1cd4fb8f7bf. Self-hosted System One endpoint. Text only: the checkpoint loads no vision tower, so image rows use their text rendering. GPU cost is recorded separately, never inferred from Kev 4B OpenRouter token pricing.

models.label: Sarvam-Prism

pricing.note: Published rate Rs 4 per 1M input tokens, GST excluded, converted at the FBIL reference rate of Rs 94.8606 per USD on 3 Nov 2026. Output tokens are not billed.

models.notes: Sarvam's hosted Decisions API (POST /v2/systemone). Text only: image rows get their text rendering.

models.label: Sarvam-Prism (self-hosted)
models.notes: Sarvam-Prism FP8 open weights, pinned Hub revision 417cf26c2eea27286a803dd721b4e78698bdb875, served with Sarvam's prism.py on one Modal GPU, B200 requested with H200 fallback (scripts/serve_prism.py). Text only. GPU cost is recorded separately, never as token pricing.

models.label: Quyet 1.2 Large
models.notes: Open weights at chinhnc/Quyet-1.2-Large, pinned Hub revision ffad03b6f20aa548ba2e045410e9fcafe4ddf0d2, served with quyet 1.2.0 and transformers 5.17.0 via scripts/serve_quyet.py in BF16 on one 80 GB GPU. Text only. GPU time is an infrastructure cost, not token pricing. The harness ran on the same machine as the server, so the published median latency includes no network time.

models.label: Drex Max
models.notes: Nace production System One API, native Choice probabilities. Text and image evidence are sent to Drex Max; no model fallback.

models.label: Amos 1 large
models.notes: Amos 1 large (27B, open weights at huggingface.co/mukaddamzaid/amos-1-large) served by its own System One server; text and image evidence (images sent as data URIs), native probabilities in one forward pass.

models.label: Sieve-31B-v3
models.notes: Sieve-31B-v3 (full fine-tune of gemma-4-31B-it, bf16 weights, pinned Hub revision 8fcee858f7f20a50bfa3c8f984c22adb3cbb46a2), served with sieve-serve: it reads the state once and returns the probabilities of the option labels, with no text generation. Text only; image rows are answered from their text rendering. Run on 2x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB in one node, the model's layers split over both GPUs, with the client on the same node (loopback); the latency reflects that setup.

models.label: Bielik One 4B r1
models.notes: speakleash/Bielik-One-4B-r1 public revision 567d29b0f15df28794acf0f6187f9216860d4551; BF16; bielik-one runtime 881089d201c806a1a67268a4190aeecdad3d8fac; vLLM 0.32.0; context 32768. Native-validation temperatures fitted before benchmark inference; zero exact normalized context/document overlap found against bench-v4 (not a paraphrase test). Full profile and inference-file hashes: docs/evaluations/bielik-one-4b-r1.json. Self-hosted A100 loopback latency excludes the public network; cost unavailable, not zero. Full corpus text representations, no images.
